subject: Renewal: Verdant AI — capacity hedge + price conservation proposal
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Asha Nair <asha@verdantai.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@verdantai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Verdant AI renewal: proposal for 12-month renewal + capacity hedge

Hi Asha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday — great to hear how the new image ingestion pipeline is driving additional inference across your dev and staging clusters. Per our conversation, I put together a concise renewal proposal that aims to lock in price stability while giving you headroom for expected spike growth this year. High-level:

- Term: 12 months (starts 2027-06-01)
- Current list rates: unchanged; proposal is a price-conservation amendment (see details)
- Capacity hedge: reserved buffer pool of 30% of last-12-month peak, available as burstable capacity for sustained surges
- Credits: one-time usage credit to smooth transition to the new commit cadence (provisional ask: $80k)

I've attached a short historical usage export (Verdant_Usage_Historical_Qs.csv) and a draft amendment that documents the hedge mechanics and usage smoothing. I tried to balance predictability for Verdant (price hold) with our need to manage capacity economics.

If this direction looks reasonable, I'd like to schedule a 30-minute call next week to walk the package with your finance and platform teams and agree on the mutual action plan. Proposed times: Tue 4/20 10:00am PDT or Wed 4/21 2:00pm PDT.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Asha Nair <asha@verdantai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@verdantai.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Verdant AI renewal: proposal for 12-month renewal + capacity hedge

Vivek — thanks for the summary and the file. We appreciate Redwood moving quickly. A few clarifying points from our side: 

1) The buffer pool is useful, but the $80k credit ask is higher than we were expecting. Last year our annualized consumption across prod + training-sim hit ~900M infer tokens; our CFO is looking for sticker closer to 10% blended off list or equivalent credits.
2) We'd prefer a 24-month term to smooth cost and avoid frequent renegotiation — are there incentives for multi-year?
3) Important for procurement: auditability of burst consumption (we need detailed per-route token logs for billing reconciliation).

Would be good to have Ben and finance on the call. Tue 4/20 10am PDT works for us.

Asha
Director of Platform Engineering
Verdant AI
asha@verdantai.com

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 09:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message attached)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Verdant AI renewal: proposal for 12-month renewal + capacity hedge

Folks — forwarding Verdant's reply. TL;DR: they want deeper pricing (approx 10% off/list equivalence) and prefer 24 months. They also need finer telemetry for billing reconciliation.

Key asks to consider for the call Tuesday:
- Convert $80k one-time credit ask -> equivalent blended discount (they asked for ~10%); can we do 12% for 12 months or 8% for 24 months?
- Can we offer a conditional multi-year incentive: 10% year-1, 7% year-2 with rollover credits if usage exceeds the hedge?
- We must confirm we can provide per-route token logs in exportable form for reconciliation. Monica, can CS own the logs scope?

I'm proposing the following optional offers to present on Tues:
A) 24-month conservation: 8% off list each year + $50k usage credit; buffer pool 30% as proposed
B) 12-month more aggressive: 12% off list + $60k credit; buffer pool 30%

Lauren — do we have latitude to sign off on A or B for a strategic account like Verdant? If not, what concession matrix should we use (discount ceiling, credits, approval path)? I can soften commitment language with conditional usage thresholds.

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Verdant AI renewal: proposal for 12-month renewal + capacity hedge

Vivek — thanks for the context and clear options. Given Verdant's strategic potential and predictable consumption profile, we can approve a middle-ground commercial that preserves economics while addressing their request. My recommended offer to present: 

Final commercial (approved):
- Term: 24 months (preferred by customer)
- Pricing: 10% off list Year 1, 6% off list Year 2 (blended ~8% across term)
- One-time usage credit: $50,000 applied in Q1 of renewal term to offset true-up volatility
- Buffer pool: 30% burstable capacity; usage counts against true-up at a discounted overage rate (40% of list) to protect both parties
- Auditability: we will deliver per-route token export (daily CSV) and token-level trace for disputed billing windows (Monica to coordinate SOW items)
- Conditions: signed amendment plus a 30-day committed billing cadence and acceptance of data export format.

Please present this as our best and final commercial; if Verdant presses for deeper discount, escalate to me but we should avoid greater than 12% in any single year without exec approval. Also include an explicit clause that credits are one-time and non-recurring.

I will draft the amendment language and sign-off matrix. Once Verdant verbally accepts, route the doc to DocuSign (use the internal approval tag for any >$75k credit).

Lauren
VP, Finance - Commercial Deals
Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Asha Nair <asha@verdantai.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@verdantai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Verdant AI renewal — final commercial and next steps

Asha / Tom — thanks again for the discussion today. We had an internal review and can move forward with the following commercial that balances Verdant's desire for multi-year stability with our capacity economics: 

1) Term: 24 months (2027-06-01 through 2029-05-31)
2) Pricing: 10% off list in Year 1; 6% off list in Year 2
3) One-time usage credit: $50,000 applied to the first invoice after term start
4) Buffer pool: 30% of historical peak available as burst pool; burst usage billed at 40% of list when counted against true-up (gives you headroom while preserving fairness)
5) Auditability: Redwood will provide daily per-route token CSV export and a token reconciliation window (Monica to follow up with SOW and format)

Attached is the Renewal_Amendment_Draft.pdf and a short Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx outlining milestones (sign, billing start, data handoff, kick-off). If that all looks good, please confirm and I'll route the amendment for signature (DocuSign link included here for your convenience). Once executed, Monica and her team will schedule the kickoff to finalize token export format and ingestion plan.

Next steps:
- Confirm acceptance by 2027-04-23 to preserve proposed pricing
- Sign amendment via DocuSign (link below)
- Kickoff to set telemetry/ops details (Monica will propose times once signed)

DocuSign (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/session/embeddedSigning?doc=VA-Renewal-4721

Thanks and looking forward to continuing the partnership.

Best,
Vivek
